method: Same seeds and full public selftest on pristine, each single mutant, and exact restoration. Fresh seed pairs between mutants. Counter and selftest subprocesses joined synchronously; maximum three at once; no background jobs or subagents. Timeout wrappers: counters 900 s, selftest 1180 s; each 2 GiB address-space and 4096 process cap. All TMPDIR/C2_TMP paths stay in the assigned scratch directory.

expected_detector_inference.casefold: [INFERENCE] Comparing only after lowercase validation is equivalent for normal sha256sum output; both detectors should survive.
expected_detector_inference.catbytes: [INFERENCE] Exact-byte/newline counter classes and matching-pin selftest cases should kill.
expected_detector_inference.failopen: [INFERENCE] Counter and selftest appear to lack sha256sum failure injection; survival would be a coverage gap.
expected_detector_inference.spanfirst: [INFERENCE] S4_mismatch_span_absent should kill; claims-sha-stale may miss per-claim precedence because its observed=stale token is aggregate.
expected_detector_inference.nofinding: [INFERENCE] Finding-aware counter and claims-sha-stale should kill.

setup_incident: First clone setup exited 254 after ulimit -u 256 prevented bash forks under the shared user. Retry with ulimit -u 4096 succeeded; no detector was run at the failed cap.
